title: Login fails for new users
description: New users receive an error after submitting valid credentials.
stepsToReproduce: 1. Open login page; 2. Enter valid credentials; 3. Click Login

title: Token refresh returns 401
description: An expired access token is not refreshed; users are logged out during active sessions.
stepsToReproduce: 1. Sign in; 2. Wait for token expiry; 3. Call a protected endpoint

title: Dashboard loads slowly
description: Dashboard takes more than 8 seconds to load for users with large project histories.
stepsToReproduce: 1. Sign in; 2. Open dashboard; 3. Refresh twice

title: Typo in help text
description: Minor spelling mistake in the password reset message.
stepsToReproduce: 1. Open password reset page; 2. Read help text

title: Intermittent checkout timeout
description: Checkout sometimes times out under load, but retrying succeeds; investigate logs and reproduce with concurrent requests.
stepsToReproduce: 1. Add items; 2. Start several concurrent checkouts; 3. Inspect request logs

title: CSV export corrupts Unicode
description: Exported CSV replaces some accented characters with question marks.
stepsToReproduce: 1. Create a record with Unicode; 2. Export CSV; 3. Inspect the file

title: Search ignores hyphens
description: Search does not find a record when the query contains a hyphenated identifier.
stepsToReproduce: 1. Search for a hyphenated identifier; 2. Compare results

title: Session remains active after password reset
description: The session should be invalidated after a password reset, but existing browser sessions can still access protected pages for a short period.
stepsToReproduce: 1. Sign in on two browsers; 2. Reset password in one; 3. Reuse the other session

title: Notification badge does not clear
description: Unread notification count remains visible after all notifications have been opened.
stepsToReproduce: 1. Open all notifications; 2. Return to dashboard

title: Null pointer in audit view
description: Opening an older audit record with a missing optional actor field throws an exception instead of displaying an unknown actor.
stepsToReproduce: 1. Open an older audit entry with no actor; 2. Observe the page

title: Dark mode support
description: Add a dark theme for the helpdesk portal.
businessJustification: Users have requested a dark theme to reduce eye strain.

title: Bulk ticket assignment
description: Allow managers to assign multiple tickets at once.
businessJustification: Bulk assignment will reduce repetitive manual work for the support team.

title: Export daily report
description: Allow CSV export of the end-of-day report.
businessJustification: Useful for sharing daily metrics with management.

title: Saved search filters
description: Let support agents save and reuse complex ticket filters across sessions.
businessJustification: Repeated filters slow down triage; saved filters should reduce repetitive work.

title: Bulk close resolved tickets
description: Allow authorized supervisors to close multiple resolved tickets after a review.
businessJustification: Supervisors need a faster way to clear reviewed resolved tickets.

title: Keyboard navigation
description: Add keyboard shortcuts for moving through the ticket board and opening a selected ticket.
businessJustification: Keyboard navigation improves accessibility for users who avoid a mouse.

title: Audit export in JSON
description: Provide a JSON export option alongside CSV for automated downstream processing.
businessJustification: Automated compliance tools need structured audit data and manual conversion is error-prone.

title: Ticket templates
description: Allow agents to create reusable templates for common access requests and incident reports.

title: Custom SLA rules by priority
description: Let administrators configure response-time targets separately for each priority and ticket type.
businessJustification: Different request classes have different response expectations; configurable rules would make reporting more accurate.

title: Add ticket watchers
description: Allow additional team members to follow ticket updates without becoming the assignee.
businessJustification: Stakeholders need visibility into progress without changing ownership.

title: Read-only database access
description: Request read-only access to the analytics database.

title: Write access to staging system
description: Request write access for testing a deployment.

title: Production admin access
description: Request temporary administrator access for incident recovery.

title: Read access to billing dashboard
description: Grant read access to the internal billing dashboard for quarterly reconciliation.

title: Temporary write access to log archive
description: Grant time-limited write access to the log archive so the incident response team can upload sanitized diagnostics.

title: Admin access to test cluster
description: Request administrator privileges on the isolated test cluster to validate an upgrade procedure.

title: Read access to customer metrics
description: Request read-only access to customer metrics for investigating a support escalation.

title: Emergency write access to production logs
description: Emergency write access is requested to attach diagnostics during an active production incident; access must be reviewed and removed after recovery.

title: Read access to deployment history
description: Grant access to deployment history for a new engineer joining the on-call rotation.

title: Write access to analytics sandbox
description: Request write access to an isolated sandbox for validating an ETL change before it is promoted.
